claim: Past 100%, crit rate rolls extra tiers: 200% crits twice, 198% once plus 98% for a second.
code: ⌊e⌋ guaranteed tiers, plus one more with probability e − ⌊e⌋.

claim: Each crit tier adds 50% plus bonus crit DMG.
code: Each tier adds the whole crit DMG stat; a 50% base would be data, not code.

claim: Past 100% crit rate, +10% crit DMG beats +10% crit rate.
code: Expected crit is 1 + CDR × e: crit DMG wins only while e > CDR; 100% isn't the line.

claim: Weapon line: take crit rate when the rate's last two digits are 30 or more, else crit DMG.
code: Expected damage is linear in crit rate; the digits change the spread, not the mean.

ref.title: Weapon: crit rate or crit dmg

claim: The raid boss has no crit resistance.
code: Crit RES subtracts straight from crit rate; the boss's value is data.

claim: Accuracy is useless on the Guild Conquest boss.
code: No miss roll at all when the target's Avoidance is 0.

claim: Enemy DEF floors at 0.
code: DEF is clamped at 0 when buffs apply and again in the damage step.

claim: Leak: skill amp +1% ≈ +2% damage.
code: One cookie's damage step gives at most +1% ÷ (1 + amp), but buffers' amp also grows their buffs; the team total needs skill data.

ref.title: Stat weights on the Season 6 #1's account

claim: His calculator: skill amp +1% ≈ +0.45%, crit DMG +1% ≈ +0.38%.
code: 0.01 ÷ (1 + amp) fits amp ≈ 122%; the crit figure fits e ÷ (1 + CDR × e).

ref.title: Stat weights on the Season 6 #1's account

claim: Leak: crit DMG +15% ≈ +4%, crit rate +15% ≈ +3%.
code: The two gains' ratio is e ÷ CDR: about 1.3 on his account.

ref.title: Stat weights on the Season 6 #1's account

claim: Leak: ATK +650 ≈ +2.5% damage.
code: ATK is linear, a flat base line scaled by battle ATK%; needs his base ATK to check.

ref.title: Stat weights on the Season 6 #1's account

claim: The Piñata is Dark, weak to Light.
code: Dark also beats Light; resistance wins when C_dec + the boss's element RES > 0.

claim: The boss's damage reduction ramps 10/30/50/70/90%.
code: Damage × (1 − DR), DR stacking as a screen: early hits are worth the most.

claim: Lift resistance stacks as base + extra − base × extra.
code: Knockback and airborne RES stack as a screen, clamped to 0–100%.

claim: Macaron's and Chardonnay's crit buffs don't stack.
code: Within one group only the largest stack × strength counts; whether the two share a group is data.

claim: Cheesecake's ATK buff overrides Milk's on the same cookie: 228K kept over Milk's 483K.
code: A group keeps the larger stack × strength, not a fixed order. Fits only if Milk's stacks were low then, or they share an ID.

claim: Best case: Cheesecake buffs Milk first, and Milk's buff then gives 667K.
code: Milk's buff is sized from her ATK when she casts, buffs she holds included.

claim: Skill amp no longer boosts stat-reduction debuffs.
code: Debuffs never take the caster's amp: a hard-coded category check. A server list can exclude more stats.

claim: Debuff chance = base × (focus ÷ resist + focus% − resist%).
code: Exactly this for debuffs and crowd control; no resist counts as 1, and tenacity shortens them.

claim: Buffs scale with the caster's skill amp: ⌊base × value × (1 + amp)⌋.
code: ⌊value × base × (1 + caster amp)⌋, computed once when the buff lands; not for debuffs or excluded stats.

ref.title: Buffs scale with the caster's skill amp

claim: A buff given as a share of the caster's ATK or HP scales with that stat.
code: The base is the caster's ATK, max(DEF, 0) or HP, taken when she casts.

ref.title: A share-of-stat buff scales with that stat

claim: Chardonnay's crit buff grows with skill amp; only her Push RES doesn't.
code: Crit lines take the caster's amp unless excluded; push and airborne RES lines add raw.

ref.title: Chardonnay's crit buff scales with skill amp

claim: A Pomegranate beam on a buffer adds more damage than another dealer would.
code: Amp a buffer holds when she casts scales every amp-scaled buff of that cast; the size is skill data.

claim: Sugar Pocket: battle stats are ⌊base × (1 + Σ%) + Σflat⌋.
code: ApplyBonus does exactly this for HP, ATK and DEF.

claim: The power gate multiplies final damage, last.
code: The penalty is the last factor before the floor.

ref.title: The power gate is a step function on final damage

claim: The power gate cuts only your team's damage, not the boss's.
code: The penalty applies only to hits on the Enemy side.

ref.title: What the gate does not touch

claim: The same power gate covers the daily dungeons, the Implant Tower and the Rift.
code: The Rift and daily dungeon controllers hold a penalty; the Implant Tower wasn't traced. Guild Conquest's holds none.

ref.title: The same table gates other content

claim: PvP's power correction is fixed at 100%.
code: Arena controllers hold a PvP penalty from a server table the client doesn't carry.

ref.title: What the gate does not touch

claim: crumblehub's damage code: these factors, in this order, with the element override.
code: Same factors, same order, same override, crit tiers and hit chance; its constants are unconfirmed defaults.
